display_name: Tri-SIG-TIME 多分支弱信道训练时序
scope: F0 Main split, original complete reference-response PAMF with three SIG-TIME views and fixed permutation [0,5,3,6,2,1,4,7]. Three variants and seeds 2026092701/02/03. F0 is an exposed development benchmark.
initialization: Exact original source-only same-seed Tri-SIG-TIME E20; own E10+E20 to fixed E50 and 11100 cumulative updates. Same source roles, original labeled losses, U pseudo-label rules, random pairing, gradient guard, and inference head.
method: Same actual five-branch source cross-RX L-anchor certificate, same source practical simulator and all probes as prior weak branch .25. Selected U physical slots interpolate raw and channel IQ by registered schedule; 0 means exact raw. The certificate evaluates the full-strength simulated view in all epochs. All variants calculate the simulator and probes even when strength is zero, so compute and branch exposure are matched. Early/late share nominal 15 active epochs but adaptive accepted counts can differ. Taper uses strength 0 on epoch 50. This is a fixed schedule comparison using the previously proposed physics-aware multi-branch method, with no additional U teacher, change of default head or target-derived per-class weights.
controls: prior fixed-strength .25 branch route, reused from 20261111-phase1-pamf-tri-weak-practical-f0-m9-r01 after score freeze
evaluation: Fixed E50; clean and six practical scenes. DURA-LU primary, DURA-L and raw secondary; combined disjoint cross_rx+cross_both have 168000 packets per scene; cross_date diagnostic. All nine prediction matrices freeze before independent truth-last scores. Report each seed and scene, TX/RX/day, matched packet corrections and regressions. No leo_weak.
success: Exceed Tri three-seed mean on clean and six-scene mean; exceed ordinary PL in every scene on three-seed mean. Record every seed/scenario and all subgroup losses. Stronger all-condition claim additionally requires each seed/scene vs PL positive and independent settings.
environment: N607 ordinary account, project Python, immutable release and unique run/output root, FP32/TF32 off.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --scheduled-practical --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
resources: GPU 0–7; no more than two observed or pending workers per card including other owners. One owner and nine-row actual E20 source-only smoke.
stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch while healthy workers and outputs remain. No target-driven tuning, checkpoint selection, rerun, optional source diagnostic or weak scoring.
expected_artifacts: Nine source-only real E20 finite smoke checks
Own E30/E50 and strength-weighted actual U exposure
Independent paired same-packet three-seed DURA/raw analysis
